sections.heading: We Don't Just Run Ads. We Build Your Online Growth System.
sections.content:
FortuneMarq is a digital marketing agency built specifically for local businesses in Karnataka. We're based right here in Hubli — we understand the local market, the local customer, and what actually works here.

Most agencies run ads, send you a report, and disappear. We work differently. Before we spend a rupee on ads, we build the foundation — your online presence, your visibility, your trust signals. Everything connected into one system that brings you consistent leads.

Every decision we make is backed by real data. Not guesswork.

layers.outcome: You exist online. People can find you and trust what they see.

You stay connected with leads and customers. Your business runs smarter.
Consistent online leads. Growing brand trust. Market leadership in {{niche}} in {{city}}.

pages.heading: What We Found About Your Market
pages.description: Auto-populated from lead profile. Content varies by lead type.

A.label: Already Ranking
A.intro: {{searchVolume}} people search for '{{nicheKeyword}}' in {{city}} every month. Your business is currently showing up in Google's top results — that's a strong position most of your competitors haven't reached.
A.finding: We analysed how much of that monthly search traffic is reaching you directly versus going to competitors below you. There's a clear gap — and a real opportunity to capture more of it before your competitors start investing seriously in their online presence.
A.opportunity: The businesses that protect and grow their online position now will own their market in {{city}} for years. The ones that don't will spend twice as much later trying to recover it.

B.label: Has Website, Not Ranking
B.intro: {{searchVolume}} people search for '{{nicheKeyword}}' in {{city}} every month. Your business has a website — which puts you ahead of many competitors. But right now your website isn't showing up when people search.
B.finding: That means every month, {{searchVolume}} people are actively looking for exactly what you offer in {{city}} — and they're finding other businesses instead. Your website exists but it isn't working for you yet.
B.opportunity: This is fixable — and right now is the best time to fix it. Once your website starts ranking, that monthly search demand starts coming to you. Every month you wait is another month that traffic goes elsewhere.

C.label: No Website, GMB Only
C.intro: {{searchVolume}} people search for '{{nicheKeyword}}' in {{city}} every month. Most of those people look for a website before deciding who to call — it's how they judge whether a business is trustworthy and professional.
C.finding: Right now, without a website, a significant portion of that monthly demand is going directly to competitors who have an online presence. You're on Google Maps which helps — but that's capturing only a fraction of the total opportunity available.
C.opportunity: Most {{niche}} businesses in {{city}} haven't built a proper online presence yet. That means moving now gives you the first-mover advantage — you build the trust and visibility before your competitors realise the opportunity.

D.label: Low Search Volume
D.intro: Direct search volume for {{niche}} in {{city}} is limited — but the local demand for your service is very real. It comes through Google Maps, social media, word of mouth, and referral — not just direct search.
D.finding: Most {{niche}} businesses in {{city}} haven't set up any of these channels properly. That means the demand exists but it's going to whoever is most visible and trusted online — which right now isn't a crowded space.
D.opportunity: The businesses that build their online presence first in a local market like this lock in that position. Once trust is established with local customers, late movers find it very hard to compete.
